sliders.label: Spending spillover to Chinatown
sliders.help: 0 means spending stays inside the stadium district (The Battery pattern). 1 means it spreads into Chinatown. This sets the sign for tenant businesses (an open question).

sliders.label: Vulnerability amplifies losses by
sliders.help: Multiplies each segment's vulnerability before it amplifies losses. 0 switches the amplification off.

sliders.label: Knock-on: traffic lowers spending
sliders.help: Share of the traffic shift that is subtracted from spending nearby.

sliders.label: Knock-on: transit raises land value
sliders.help: Share of the transit shift added to land values.

sliders.label: Knock-on: land value raises retail competition
sliders.help: Share of the land value shift added to competition for local retail.

sliders.label: Land trust: share of exposed parcels in trust
sliders.help: How far the land trust scales the land value weight toward zero for eligible segments.

sliders.label: CBA or ordinance: cut to named losses
sliders.help: Share by which each named negative weight shrinks.

sliders.label: Chance the CBA holds
sliders.help: Share of runs in which the agreement takes effect. Related can decline a CBA. An ordinance is more likely to hold once it passes.
